metadata.executor: Agent-tool subagents, one per eval, each pointed at a copy of fixtures/<id>/inputs as its working directory, with SKILL.md loaded and no browser, web, calendar, email, or connector access
metadata.notes: Graded against each trial's written report and its final reply. Eval 2, 4, and 6 trials stop to ask the user, as the skill directs, so their expectations are checked against the draft and question in the reply. All six with-skill evals were rerun after event emojis and scripts/game_minutes.py were added; every minute in these runs comes from the script. Eval 6 was rerun after Step 2 stopped asking for a missing opponent roster; it now writes 'No opponent roster' and says so in the reply. Evals 1, 3, 5, and 6 were rerun after photos moved to their own Photos section with italic captions, the Rosters heading was dropped, player names were unbolded, and a note's written minute was ranked above its own timestamp; evals 2 and 4 write no report and carry over. Eval 6 expects the written 77'. The recording check (reading jersey numbers from video) is not exercised: trials have no recording access.
